thread: Jordan: heads up — noticed a customer report where reconnecting a streaming session after a truncation causes provisional tokens to stick and then confirmed tokens get applied too, effectively double-charging briefly.
extra: Rachel: can you paste the trace id? we need to see router handoff + resume path
note: Jordan: trace: trace-0a7c. Steps: client opens stream -> midresponse truncation (client EOF) -> reconnect w/ resume_token -> router routes to fallback worker -> worker replays suffix -> console shows provisional charge 150 then confirmed 150 = 300
reply1: Tim: thanks. suspecting our provisional ledger mark isn't being cleared on resume when worker decides replay is suffix-only. I've seen the same in traces where session.finalized=false but provisional ledger already committed.
reply2: Rachel: quick idea — add a per-session flag 'billing_finalized' in the internal route context that only flips true on explicit close or explicit commit ack from the runtime. Router would only emit provisional charges when billing_finalized=false and on final close emit confirmed charge and clear provisional tag.
reply3: Alex: that's doable, but we need to be careful w/ retries. If a client reconnects and router replays tokens we shouldn't re-emit provisional for the same prefix. need idempotency key at billing layer. maybe use streaming_session_id + resume_seq.
reply4: Maria: console UX ask — can we show 'tentative' vs 'final' tokens in the per-route breakdown? customers keep seeing spikes and open tickets. even a small badge explaining "tentative until session finalizes" would reduce support noise.
reply5: Jordan: agreed. from ops POV, the immediate low-risk change is telemetry: tag every billing event with {streaming_session_id, resume_reason, event_kind: provisional|confirmed, idempotency_key}. then we can reconcile graphs and build dashboard widgets.
code_snippet:
Rachel: proposed small API patch (internal router->billing):

POST /internal/billing-event {
  "session_id": "<uuid>",
  "resume_seq": 42,
  "event_kind": "provisional",  // provisional|confirmed
  "idempotency_key": "<hex>",
  "tokens": 150
}

We'd treat provisional as a non-final row until a confirmed arrives with same idempotency_key or until explicit finalize event arrives.
reply6: Tim: +1. Also add a 'resume_reason' string: client_reconnect|worker_replay|client_eof. helps distinguish truncation-caused resumes from simple network flaps.
reply7: Alex: one wrinkle — sidecar prefetch background embeddings sometimes produce provisional charges w/o a session_id. For those we should keep existing behavior; new logic gated on presence of streaming_session_id.
reply8: Jordan: ops-bot: create ticket and assign owners?
ops-bot_msg: ops-bot: created ticket PLATFORM-1234: 'streaming session provisional/confirmed double-charge - api field & telemetry' assigned to Rachel. Incident severity: P3. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLATFORM-1234
reply9: Rachel: I'll own API change + tests. plan: add billing_finalized flag to route context, emit provisional with idempotency_key, add finalize endpoint. will post PR tomorrow.
reply10: Tim: I'll add two metrics: billing.provisional_count and billing.reconciliation_gap (confirmed - provisional by session) and a small dashboard tile. will add alert if gap > 20 tokens sustained for 5m.
reply11: Maria: I'll prototype a console UI patch that shows tentative tokens in grey and confirmed in solid. simple copy: 'Tentative tokens (finalized after session close)'. put behind a feature flag.
reply12: Alex: test plan suggestion: 1) simulate truncation+reconnect case 2) simulate reconnect that replays suffix only 3) simulate worker restart during resume. want to add a harness case that asserts no net double-charge after confirm/clear.
reply13: Jordan: can we also emit a short-term audit log entry on finalize with last_known_prefix and idempotency_key so billing ops can reconcile user complaints quickly?
reply14: Rachel: yes, we'll emit billing.audit.finalize events for 90d retention. add to schema.
reply15: Tim: tentative timeline — Rachel PR + unit tests by EOD tomorrow, integration test in canary on thursday, dashboard & console after that. ops-bot, update ticket accordingly.
final: ops-bot: ticket PLATFORM-1234 updated: owners assigned (Rachel, Tim, Maria), target: canary rollout 2026-03-25. comments: keep telemetry verbose for initial 24h. :thumbsup:
meta: Jordan: thanks all — follow-ups in the ticket. leaving this thread open for any edgecases folks find.
